key.name: minimize
key.summary: How a window goes into the dock and comes back
key.description: droplet: it gathers into a drop of glass and arcs into its icon. shrink: GNOME's own, it shrinks and fades into its icon. With Reduce motion on, a window fades in place either way.

key.name: workspace-switch
key.description: depth: the wallpaper slides a third as far as the windows, which step back a little on the way. slide: GNOME's own.
